_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score moved ±2 in only 3% of recent 12h windows with no 24h catalyst, so the Denial coil is the graded base-rate call until funding or fear breaks the band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary/non-long, but analyst explicit HOLD-Denial vs narrative leverage-stress story without a forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear holds mid-30s, funding near flat, BTC inside recent range
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and fear_greed <25 (slide toward Panic), or fear_greed >46 with ETF flows up (lift toward Anxiety)
